name: cash.pool_balances

list.description: List native BANK cash pool balances and nested members.

purpose: Inspect native pool summary balances and member balances without aggregating or converting currencies.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native pool identity; original string or integer type retained.

fields.name: currentBalance
fields.meaning: Pool book balance; native UI summary currency is USD.

fields.name: currentAviBalance
fields.meaning: Pool amount available for payments; native UI summary currency is USD.

fields.name: closeBalance
fields.meaning: Pool book balance for the previous statement day.

fields.name: closeAviBalance
fields.meaning: Pool available balance for the previous statement day.

fields.name: mainCurrency
fields.meaning: Pool configuration currency; does not describe summary balance currency.

fields.name: valueDate
fields.meaning: Pool balance date; no member observation time is inferred.

fields.name: cashPoolMemberVOS
fields.meaning: Native members: original amounts use currency; equivalent amounts use bankCurrency.

identity_description: Native id identifies each pool; string and integer identities remain distinct.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant and BANK category; pageSize=100 with zero-based rowStart offsets.
No native page echo; completeness requires stable total, arrival and unique identity agreement.
Native values, unknown fields, decimal precision and null/empty/zero distinctions are retained without historical whitelisting.
One row per pool; members are identified within their pool. Pool totals remain independent source values and are never added to members.
Native UI pool summary amounts use USD; mainCurrency is configuration. Member currencies remain native, including null or empty unknown currency values.
Current and available balances need not agree or be ordered; previous close means previous statement day, not necessarily yesterday.
No member observation time is inferred from valueDate or capture time. Native flags masterAccount/isShare remain member values.

sync.evidence: Native id identifies each pool; string and integer identities remain distinct. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
